title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00127 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:45: Lowered nt2 connector for multibowl. M/u nt2 connector on multibowl.
00:45 - 01:00: Installed master bushing and removed box ring from rotary.
01:00 - 01:15: Performed TBT for handling PR cutter BHA
01:15 - 04:15: P/u and m/u cutter BHA and RIH with same. P/u and m/u mutlibowl RT.
04:15 - 04:30: RIH w/ BHA and m/u multibowl RT in WH. Took 20 ton OP to verify RT engaged in WH. M/u TDS performed debrief after m/u BHA.
04:30 - 05:00: Performed TBT for r/d tension cylinders on PR
05:00 - 05:30: Bled off pressure in PR tension cylinders, observed 35 ton increase on weight indicator
05:30 - 07:00: Prepared WH/TENSION ring for removal
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT for removing tension cylinders with ongoing crew
07:15 - 11:30: Continued bleeding off tension cylinders. R/d tension cylinders, left the cylinders hanging from top mounting point. Secured tension cylinders. Meanwhile assisted crane with backload. Cleaned shaker pits.
11:30 - 12:00: Performed information meeting with all involved personnel for riser pulling operations.
12:00 - 15:30: R/d boat collision stool and prepared to remove centralizers from centralizer deck. Connected 3 x weco 1502 hoses to WH outlets. Meanwhile assisted crane with backload. Continued cleaning shaker pits.
15:30 - 19:00: Waited on supply boat for riser equipment meanwhile performed housekeeping on cantilever. Removed pipes and equipment from cantilever to make space for riser joints. Assisted crane with backload. Continued cleaning shaker pits.
19:00 - 19:15: Performed TBT for r/u riser handling equipment
19:15 - 20:30: R/u tailing arm and saddle on HTS. Continued to clear cantilever. Installed beams on cantilever deck for l/o riser joints.
20:30 - 21:00: Performed information meeting with all involved personnel for riser pulling operations.
21:00 - 23:45: Continued to clear cantilever. Installed deck beams on cantilever.
23:45 - 00:00: Spotted riser handling equipment. Meanwhile cleared drill floor.
